scope: An independent read-only review of anonymized brief, base-to-candidate diff and candidate code. Do not disclose policy, model, trial order, other grades or reference solution. This is grading overhead, recorded separately from delivery consumption.
criteria: Every explicit requirement is implemented without inventing unauthorized behavior.
Existing behavior remains compatible except the explicitly requested manual default and provenance boundary.
No material authorization, privacy or data-integrity defect is introduced.
Tests preserve meaningful coverage; no bypassed checks, blanket stubs, hidden errors or unrelated broad rewrites.
decision: Pass only with no substantiated P0/P1 finding and no unmet explicit requirement. Trace a reachable public call path before alleging an authorization or validation bypass; internal storage/test-fixture inputs are not automatically public API inputs. Grade requirements literally: preserving evidence means retaining inspectable records, not inventing a new UI-display requirement for every stored field. P2/P3 suggestions alone do not fail a candidate. Provide file/line, reachable scenario and smallest correction for each finding. Independent executable checks are separately required; this model cannot overrule a failed check.
